location_exception_reason: Auditorium roofing sheds are prefabricated steel structures sold as turnkey projects; location of manufacture or installation does not change the product category or buyer decision logic. Venue type (marriage hall, church, community auditorium) drives buyer intent, not geographic origin.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Contractor, Fabricator) describe who is selling, not what is being sold; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from a title leaves the product definition complete and unchanged.
